adjudication.rationale: The diff adds nontrivial multi-host/collective behavior in `handleNewBooking.ts` by collecting team members’ destination calendars (`teamDestinationCalendars.push(user.destinationCalendar)` under `isTeamEventType && eventType.schedulingType === "COLLECTIVE"`) and later appending them to `evt.destinationCalendar` (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`). It also refactors downstream logic to support multiple calendar references (e.g., `updateCalendarEvent()` now uses `filter` and loops over references; cancel path similarly switches from `find` to `filter`). In the shown diff, the only explicit test change is an e2e snapshot adjustment (`destinationCalendar: null` -> `[]`), and there are no new assertions/coverage added for these new multi-destination/multi-reference behaviors. That makes the finding a specific, diff-grounded “missing test coverage for new logic” concern rather than a directly provable runtime defect.
